title: GORGAN – Oct. 8,  The devoted forces of Gorgan remain steadfast in their support of Iran.
text:
GORGAN – Oct. 8,  The devoted forces of Gorgan remain steadfast in their support of Iran."

"A parade featuring Iran’s “Jan-Fada” (Self-Sacrificing) battalions took place, with 130 marching units and battalions participating. Participants trampled a U.S. flag and demonstrated their readiness for potential battle.
